overlaps.rationale: Both are written information, but notice is general written information intended to inform people, whereas notification is specifically a message alert from an application or service.
A warning is specifically information about possible danger or trouble; notice is a broader category of written information and has a distinct general sense.
An appointment reminder is a specific notice reminding someone of a scheduled appointment, not the general written-information sense of notice.
